name: Audity DJ
author: Audity
description: The talking DJ for the Audity app, on Navidrome, Jellyfin or Plex: its voice made on this server only while a DJ session is on, and what the DJ remembers for each account, shared by all your devices.

versions.changelog: Lines at the voice's full quality (44.1 kHz) for the Audity builds that play it; earlier builds still get 24 kHz.

Jellyfin and Plex accounts sign in too; the voices are named Theo and Juno; lines said before are kept and sent at once; a line is sent the moment it's made; songs that sound alike for the server you signed in to; the crackle between pauses fixed; the page's downloads and voices kept to AudioMuse-AI's admins.
First release: the DJ's voice (Ming-3.0-tts 0.5B on the processor), two voices and your own, lines checked with speech-to-text, and the DJ's memory per Navidrome account.
